# `codes.grow.packages:grafana-tempo` — agent quickstart (Java 17+)

Ships inside the jar at `META-INF/grow/grafana-tempo/AGENTS.md`
(`unzip -p grafana-tempo-X.Y.Z.jar META-INF/grow/grafana-tempo/AGENTS.md`). Docs:
https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/grafana-tempo/ · Service: Grafana Tempo · Categories: tracing ·
Package `codes.grow.packages.tempo`.

## Client

```java
try (TempoClient client = TempoClient.fromEnv()) { // GROW_GRAFANA_TEMPO_* > vendor env > defaults
  client.health();
}
```

Errors: `TempoException` subclasses (`ConfigException`, `NotFoundException`, …) with `code()`.

## Tracing

The tracing entry point (`initTracing` / `InitTracing` / `init_tracing`) and its options are documented in the
package README and https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/grafana-tempo/tracing/ (span helpers `withSpan`, `traced`,
`currentTraceId`, HTTP middleware).
